title: Urgent: Buy Before October 28 (Investors Will FLOOD Into These Stocks)
creator: MarketBeat
source_note: Detailed summary generated from video captions; auto-captions garble names/numbers in places
summary: MarketBeat host Bridget interviews analyst Chris Marotch ahead of the late-October Fed meeting, where Cleveland Fed President Beth Hammack has argued rates may need to rise further with inflation above target for over five years. With the 10-year Treasury yielding about 5.2%, Marotch argues investors need not flee to bonds: three stocks under $30 each yield more than the 10-year while offering price upside. Pfizer (PFE, BUY, under $30 stated) trades at roughly 9.5x forward earnings with a ~6% yield; post-Covid revenue has normalised and the story is slow-and-steady, hinging on a deep pipeline of 'shots on goal' rather than a return to Covid highs. Energy Transfer (ET, BUY, under $30) is called the most attractive on total return: ~11.7x forward earnings, a 6.67% yield raised fractionally every quarter, consensus target near $24.50, and natural gas — the near-term winner for AI data-centre power — moving through one of the largest US midstream networks. Plains All American (PAA, BUY, under $30) is the focused Permian-to-Gulf crude play: ~14.2x forward / ~8x trailing earnings, 6.8% yield, fee-based so it is paid whether oil is $60 or $160, with UBS and Mizuho targets of $31 and $30. All three are first tracked calls; no stance flips. Caption names are garbled in places ('Fizer', 'P AAA').
